sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the claimants aggrieved by the award passed in MVC No.5032/2015, dated 14.01.2018, by the MACT, Bengaluru City.
2. The claim petition was filed seeking compensation of an amount of Rs.24,00,000/- for the death of the deceased in a road traffic accident.

The court below had granted an amount of Rs.22,21,000/-
as compensation.

When it comes to 'Liability' the court below has come to the conclusion that the driver of the offending vehicle was not having valid driving license and hence, the owner of the offending vehicle is liable to pay the compensation to the claimants and exonerated the insurance company.

3. It was submitted before the court below that even if it is a case of no license or valid driving license, NC: 2023:KHC:41466 still the insurance company is liable to pay and recover the same, the Tribunal has observed that only the Hon'ble Apex Court can apply the principle of pay and recover and the court below has no power to do so.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the claimants submits that the court below without considering the judgments of the Hon'ble Apex Court has held that only the owner is liable to pay the compensation.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the insurance company submits that the court below has rightly held the owner of the vehicle is liable as there is no valid driving license.
6. Having heard the learned counsel on either side, perused the material on record.
The only ground on which the claimants are before this Court is that the court below had exonerated the insurance company from liability on the ground that there is no valid driving license.

In the present case the deceased is a third party and even NC: 2023:KHC:41466 though there is no valid driving license to the driver of the offending vehicle still the insurance company is liable to pay the compensation and recover the same from the owner of the vehicle.
It is a settled law and the Tribunal has erred in holding that it cannot apply the principle of pay and recovery and only the Hon'ble Apex Court can apply the principle.
The claimants have not raised any other ground seeking enhancement of compensation.
7. Accordingly, the appeal of the claimants is allowed and the insurance company is liable to pay the compensation amount to the claimants and thereafter recover from the owner of the vehicle.
i) The compensation amount shall carry interest at 6% p.a., from the date of petition till the date of realization.
ii) The respondent - insurance company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of copy of the judgment.
On such deposit, the claimants are NC: 2023:KHC:41466 entitled to withdraw the entire amount without furnishing any security.
